text: Evening. I've got my granddaughter Isla staying, she's 7. She came down with a temperature this afternoon and it's 38.1 now. I'll describe what I'm seeing as best I can, because it isn't like any cold she's had before. She's lying quite still on the sofa but her chest is going up and down quick, like she's just run the length of the garden, and that's with her not moving at all. I lifted her pyjama top to have a proper look and the skin just under her ribs sinks in each time she breathes in, a little hollow there. She also makes a small 'uh' sound at the end of each breath out, very regular. Once or twice it seemed to stop for a second or two before the next one came, though I may be imagining that. To be clear, there's been no fit or shaking or anything of that sort, and her colour is her usual colour, lips pink, nothing grey or blue about her. I'm not one to fuss but I'd rather ask than sit here watching her all night. What would you advise?
